scientific_integration.title: Integrate the manuscript
scientific_integration.purpose: Read the whole argument and apply the corrections that make its claims, evidence and explanation cohere.
guidance: Read the current manuscript in order before restructuring it. Follow the exact sources and dependencies needed to judge each inference; do not substitute a summary or prior session confidence for that reading.

State the thesis and identify which constructions actually support it. Look for identities and consequences across sections, duplicated material, missing chapters and inconsistent notation or forward references.
Use scientific ambition to organise the construction. Preserve assumptions, counterexamples and precise open questions at their proper scope. Cite the actual proposition or method used.
Apply coherent corrections through existing source owners. Preserve evidence, labels and attribution. Update affected concept and section links through their owners.
completion: Corrections are applied, not merely proposed.
Read the changed explanation and inspect the resulting pages, figures, citations and references.
Record actual remaining scientific and editorial gaps. Root/author judgement is distinct from successful computation.

voice_integration.title: Integrate the author’s voice
voice_integration.purpose: Apply a sustained voice pass grounded in the selected author profile and original prose while preserving the argument.
guidance: Read the complete scoped manuscript and relevant original calibration passages before revising. Discover recorded source handles through writing_style provenance, then use writing_style_calibration or repository reads for bounded passages. A style summary is not evidence that an original was read.
Let concrete questions motivate each change of representation. Return to examples with new consequences and vary cadence with the thought. Use the selected project’s genre and audience.

Keep necessary scientific qualifications where they affect an inference. Remove repetitive defensive framing and move verification history to linked supporting notes when it does not change the argument.
Preserve mathematical content, assumptions, citations, labels, figure meaning and numerical values. Report scientific errors separately with evidence instead of silently changing them as style.
Apply the pass throughout the intended scope. Do not insert private biography, copy original prose, manufacture humour, or stop at an opening rewrite or suggestions list.
completion: Applied revisions identify the current source and selected profile revision.
Read the actual changed prose for continuity and voice, then inspect rendered pages for regressions.
Record the original passages actually read, any inaccessible sources, and substantive qualifications preserved. Do not invent an automated voice score.

presentation.title: Design and inspect the publication
presentation.purpose: Make the book’s typography, cover, figures and metadata communicate its argument.
guidance: Use the author’s exact title, byline order and affiliation. Read the active document and visual style before changing it.
Give cover art a clear conceptual purpose and distinguish it from scientific data. Use scalable artwork where appropriate. Preserve the meaning and evidence provenance of scientific figures.
Use existing style and source owners. Keep stable source paths and references unless an explicit supported rename is needed.
Inspect the actual cover, contents, chapter openings, mathematical pages and figure pages at readable scale. Source compilation alone does not establish layout quality.
completion: The delivered PDF matches the selected source and correct title/byline metadata.
Check actual links, captions, references, legibility and clipping in the app reader and exported artifact.
Refresh source/companion packages and verify extraction and links while preserving scientific run identities.

build_acceptance.title: Verify the built manuscript
build_acceptance.purpose: Verify the current build, its source identity and the pages it produced.
guidance: Use the selected-source build owner. Distinguish the latest attempt from the last successful PDF.
Inspect the compiler result and changed pages. Verify labels, citations, figure placement and source package links without rerunning unrelated scientific calculations.
completion: Record the terminal build receipt, current source/PDF hashes, page inspection and unresolved warnings.
Do not describe compilation as scientific verification.

engine_acceptance.title: Measure engine behaviour
engine_acceptance.purpose: Measure live service correctness, latency and storage growth at realistic project scale.
guidance: Record served source identity, PID, frontend bundle and active work before attributing behaviour to a change.
Measure cold/warm and active/idle paths separately. Distinguish server time, response bytes, browser rendering and durable bytes.
Use a fixture or authorised edit for mutation measurements. Keep unrelated source and sessions live. Retain readable history once, without copying it into every response.
completion: Deposit the actual commands, measurements, environment and failure observations. Historical reference samples are not current evidence or universal budgets.
Engineering host probes require host access. Report that capability as unavailable when absent, rather than inventing a writing tool or results.

ui_acceptance.title: Use and verify the interface
ui_acceptance.purpose: Exercise real user interactions in the delivered browser/native application.
guidance: Work through actual editing, navigation, evidence, history and session controls, including failure, empty, resumed and accepted states.
Use visual inspection and real actions. Keep focus and scroll position coherent and preserve unsaved drafts. Verify outcomes in the owning source/state.
Measure click-to-useful-content separately from backend time and automation snapshot overhead. Closed history and evidence detail should remain lazy but inspectable.
completion: Record exercised controls and actual outcomes, with screenshots where visual judgement matters.
If browser/native control is unavailable, return that explicit gap. Owner tests and HTTP success cannot substitute for interface acceptance.

provider_context.title: Verify session context and tools
provider_context.purpose: Test native providers on real project work and attribute context, storage and tool friction accurately.
guidance: Use small normal-project rehearsals with each requested provider. Test tool discovery, reads, guarded writes, resume, and interpretation of failures.
Measure injected orientation, changed context and explicitly requested history separately when observable. Cached cumulative input is not new prompt content.
Record every failed attempt, including payload mistakes and owner defects. Check the stored tool events against the session’s self-report.
Preserve one accessible history record and return stable handles. Repeated turns should carry changed context instead of prior full state. Do not claim full O(diff) storage without measuring it.
completion: Report provider/model and advertised/effective window, context/token measurements and observed friction.
A passing rehearsal proves only the paths and provider actually exercised.

programme.title: Develop a connected research manuscript
programme.purpose: Carry interpreted results through explicit documentary support, reader planning, draft, independent judgement, original-parent synthesis and delivered export.

phases.title: Recover and interpret results
phases.guidance: Read the exact claims and prerequisites, producer/run/result/proof records and limitations. Interpret what each current result supports. Definitions and author postulates need no invented experiment.
phases.completion: Current scoped interpretation with exact claim/result identities, assumptions and negative findings. Execution/provenance is not scientific acceptance.

phases.title: Search, read and bind support
phases.guidance: Reuse readable local sources first. Record explicit search or scoped no-new-search rationale, read actual passages through reference_text, bind receipts/locators to precise claims. Metadata and BibTeX pins are not passage support. Create targeted literature-acquisition Work where needed.
phases.completion: Passage-qualified support handoff, with remaining citation/build obligations explicit. This ordinary support Work is not final literature-acquisition completion. Keep acquisition open until literature_scope.ready_for_completion after actual citations/build.

phases.title: Improve the argument and reader plan
phases.guidance: Consume interpreted results and current qualified support. Develop the connected explanation and authored reader entry/exit states, transitions and paragraph plan. Inspect diagnostics, stale/unobserved inputs and remaining pages. Reader-plan citation pins and support passage receipts are separate.
phases.completion: Current argument/reader-plan basis and explicit authored diagnostics. These are not reader comprehension, independent review or scientific acceptance.

phases.title: Develop the connected draft
phases.guidance: Read neighbouring prose, exact plan/source/evidence inputs and author feedback. Produce source-addressed reviewable edits. Gerard's commission permits existing guarded authorized proposal/source application. Preserve direct author Save authority without repeated human Apply/Save/build gates. An unapplied proposal is not saved source. After an authorized source change, use the returned scoped re-preparation task action before completion if the consumed cut changed. This is a guarded owner action available under the commission, not a new human permission gate. Prior cuts stay in history.
phases.completion: Exact draft/proposal/application identities and consumed inputs. Any actual application uses current source guards and authorized owners, never a permission bypass.

phases.title: Obtain independent reader-sensitive judgement
phases.guidance: After production settles, a fresh independent app-owned judge reads exact draft/plan/support bytes. Diagnose missing premises, definitions, examples, transitions and what the intended reader can infer. Retain actual reading coverage, assumptions and ACCEPT/HOLD/REJECT. Do not judge your own production.
phases.completion: Exact independent disposition and consequential reader findings, not an automated score or scientific acceptance. Failed/incomplete coverage cannot qualify done.

review_obligations.label: Independent reader-sensitive judgement of exact draft, plan and evidence with actual reading coverage.

phases.title: Synthesize in the original parent
phases.guidance: Resume the original parent. Read exact prepared inputs and every available worker/judge return, including rejected outcomes. Publish parent synthesis through the current return contract where dispatch applies. Retain BLOCKED and exact recovery when evidence is rejected/incomplete. Never replay children or add a synthesis child. Record work_review phase synthesis on the exact judgement Work, consuming its current handoff and accepted independent review IDs, from the original parent's synthesis stage turn.
phases.completion: Parent-consumed exact returns, scoped decisions and follow-up Work with current guards. No replacement paid parent or serial child DAG.

phases.title: Build, inspect and deliver the export
phases.guidance: Consume actual current saved/applied source. Use existing authorized build/export owners, inspect real pages, citations and bibliography, then retain the separate export delivery receipt. Complete acquisition only when its current literature_scope.ready_for_completion is true. No extra human-click approval gate.
phases.completion: Current source/build/output identities, actual page inspection and separate export receipt. A successful build is not delivery or scientific acceptance. The ordinary export Work must retain both actual selected-source export PDF and owner receipt as evidence; the terminal owner validates the recorded export and current build.

programme.execution: Ordinary sequential stage Work in one original parent session. Preparation/read starts no model. One active job in this lane, no serial child DAG or new scheduler. Prepare an explicit all-seven identity contract via ordinary closure obligations. Each ordinary stage binds its owner-derived scoped cut; changed input qualification requires explicit guarded re-preparation, never silent renewal.
programme.literature_boundary: The support handoff is usable before final acquisition citation/build completion. Improvement depends on the ordinary support Work, never on an acquisition Work that needs the later draft/build.
